thisWeek: Mini Shoot giveaway launches Fri 20 Nov. Dated giveaway messages are already written; keep other messages light so the giveaway stays the focus.

campaigns.title: Mini Shoot giveaway
campaigns.offer: Grand prize: 1 free Mini Shoot (R500 value: 20 edited photos or one 30 second reel, 30 minutes of coverage). Runner-up: 20% off a Mini Shoot. Every entrant: 10% off a first booking with code FOMGIVEAWAY10.
campaigns.howTo: On Instagram (@fom_studios_): follow, like the giveaway post and comment tagging 2 friends. Each new comment tagging 2 different friends is another entry. Sharing the post to your Story and tagging us is an optional bonus entry.
campaigns.rules: Entries close Sun 29 Nov 18:00 SAST. Winners drawn at random and announced by Tue 1 Dec; they must reply within 48 hours. SA residents 18+. No purchase necessary. Prizes have no cash value and must be used by 31 Jan 2027. Not sponsored by or associated with Instagram.
campaigns.notes: Do not reveal the code FOMGIVEAWAY10 before entries close on Sun 29 Nov 18:00. Bookings number: 068 690 1120.
